long_biography.plain_text:
Packaging entrepreneur Dennis Mehiel pledged college scholarships to children from his childhood neighbourhood. In 1996, thirty pupils finishing kindergarten at Washington Heights' Public School 132 were offered full tuition at Stony Brook if they gained admission after high school. His All the Way programme began with a personal donation.

Mehiel wanted to begin supporting children well before they reached secondary school. His funding also provided after-school and summer activities, with Stony Brook students serving as mentors throughout elementary school. The programme went on to take in seven successive classes of first graders.
